chunkPolicy.description: Each planned chunk covers 0.01% to 0.1% of a source work. Workers may snap boundaries to the nearest book, chapter, paragraph, line, couplet, or scene boundary during generation, but the manifest retains percentage coverage for coordination.

sources.title: Histories
sources.author: Herodotus
sources.rightsNote: Ancient Greek original is public domain; Perseus TEI repository is CC BY-SA 4.0. Keep attribution with derived text data.
sources.starterAesthetic: Ionian field notebook: reed-pen linework, sea-weathered blues, red-figure silhouette accents, clear map labels, consistent traveler-narrator presence.
